description: Evaluation dataset (generation 2) for AskWRI Answer mode evaluation - cross-lingual corpus (en/zh/es/pt). Test cases are built by manually reviewing one sampled KP at a time and drafting a high-level English query whose expected answer is that document, along with a draft answer. expected_passages is intentionally left empty - chunk/excerpt-level ground truth has not been captured at this stage.

test_cases.question: What is the projected market penetration rate of new energy heavy-duty trucks in China through 2035?

synthesis_ground_truth.canonical_answer: The document projects new energy heavy-duty truck penetration in China through 2035 under three policy scenarios: no-policy, current-policy, and enhanced-policy (current policy combined with additional enhancements). Under the no-policy scenario, regional transport penetration reaches 2%-17% by MY2030, while long-haul penetration remains at a nascent, low level all the way through MY2035. Under the current-policy scenario, the trade-in subsidy lifts long-range BEV semi-tractor penetration in regional transport to roughly 10% by MY2027. Under the enhanced-policy scenario, regional transport penetration exceeds 50% during MY2027-2030, while long-haul growth stays slow until a sharp acceleration in MY2032-2035 - implying that sustained policy support is needed through 2035 for long-haul penetration to reach meaningful levels.
key_facts: Three scenarios are modeled: no-policy, current-policy, and enhanced-policy (current + enhanced combined).
No-policy scenario: regional transport reaches 2%-17% penetration by MY2030; long-haul stays at a nascent, low level all the way through MY2035.
Current-policy scenario: the trade-in subsidy lifts long-range BEV semi-tractor penetration in regional transport to ~10% by MY2027.

Enhanced-policy scenario: regional transport penetration exceeds 50% during MY2027-2030; long-haul growth stays slow until a sharp acceleration in MY2032-2035, implying sustained policy support is needed through 2035 for long-haul to reach meaningful levels.
